params.body:
## What

Two things the Studio needs from the pipeline:

1. **Write's opening says why a starter stands out, and can browse all of them.** Each story starter carries its evidence (strength, signals, sources, platforms, how many landed this week) and whether it is this week's. `GET /articles/story-starters` takes `limit`, `offset` and `q`, and answers `more`, so the Studio can page through every candidate and search them instead of showing three.
2. **Editors arrange gentells.com's front page.**
   - A trend order: `insights.showcase_rank`. The showcase is sent ranked trends first, in the editors' order, then the rest by strength as before. `POST /site/trends/order {ids}` sets it; an empty list hands the order back to strength. The site already shows trends in the order it receives them, so the front page's six follow without a site change.
   - A lead post: `articles.featured_at`. `POST /site/lead {id}` pins one published post (`null` unpins). The old and the new lead both get a fresh `updated_at` and a projection notice, because the site re-fetches a post only when that moves. The site follows it in its own PR (gentells-site, pinned lead).
   - An undo that restores exactly: `POST /site/trends/:id` takes `action: 'restore'` with `to`, the status the previous decision replaced (its `from`), including `proposed` and none.

## Why

The front page chose itself. The newest post led and the six strongest trends filled the trend row, so the only way to lead with a better piece was to publish it later, and nobody decided what the page opened on. The Studio's Curate now draws the front page and lets an editor place things on it; these are the fields and routes it writes to.

The starters showed a headline and nothing else, so a writer could not tell why one was suggested, and three was all there was.

## Rules kept

- A trend that is hidden or skipped leaves the order, so a place is never held for something the site does not show. An order naming a trend that is not live is refused whole.
- A post that leaves the site (any status but published, or turned into own work) stops leading; the newest leads again.
- Only a published post can lead.

## Tests

- `test/front-page-order.test.mjs`: strength until ordered; ordered first, the rest by strength; leaving and returning; undo to the exact status; refusing a trend that is not live; pinning one post, moving both, refusing a post that is not live, unpinning.
- `test/story-starters-evidence.test.mjs`: the evidence numbers, the fallback when nothing is this week's, paging, search, the cap and paging without a period.

Full suite: 1148 of 1154 pass. The six failures are `report-render`, which needs `pdftoppm`; they fail the same way on main.

## Order

This can deploy before the site and the Studio: until the Studio writes them, every rank and pin is empty and the showcase is sent as today.
params.title: Editors order the front page trends and pin the lead post; starters page and search
